description_short: Raises a critical in-game alert when a significant share of the train fleet is traffic-blocked.
description_long: Monitors the game's explicit train traffic states. Players can configure how many production cycles a train must wait for track clearance before it counts as stuck. A continuous critical notification appears when at least three and at least ten percent of active trains are stuck, and clears automatically when traffic recovers. An opt-in setting pauses the game once when this mod's red alert begins.
